common.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

picker.title: Who are you?
picker.intro: Tap your name to sign in.
picker.empty: No one is on the list yet. Ask the admin to add everyone.

setPassword.intro: Choose a password. You'll use it to come back and see who you're buying a gift for.
setPassword.tooShort: The password needs at least {min} characters.
setPassword.alreadyClaimed: Someone has just set a password for this name. If it wasn't you, ask the admin.
setPassword.drawNote: The draw starts by itself once everyone has joined.
setPassword.tooLong: The password can have at most {max} characters.

enterPassword.wrongPassword: That's not the right password. Try again.
enterPassword.forgotBody: Ask the admin to reset your password. You'll set a new one next time.
enterPassword.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

waiting.waitingFor: We are waiting for {names} to sign up.
waiting.drawFailed: Everyone's in, but the draw couldn't run. The admin is on it.
waiting.joinedAfterDraw: The draw has already happened. The admin will decide whether to run it again with you in it.

reveal.title: Your match is ready
reveal.tapHint: Tap the gift to open it
reveal.secretBody: Only you can see this name. It will be here every time you log in.

me.notOnListTitle: You're no longer on the list
me.notOnListBody: The admin has removed your name. Log out, and ask the admin if this is a mistake.

participants.title: Participants
participants.summary: {total, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · {joined} joined
participants.duplicateName: Someone with this name is already on the list.
participants.removeBody: They will disappear from the list and from any spouse pair.
participants.resetPasswordBody: They will choose a new password the next time they open the app. Their draw result stays the same.

spouses.title: Spouses
spouses.intro: Spouses never draw each other. Each person can have one spouse.
spouses.pairsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No pairs} one {# pair} other {# pairs}}
spouses.alreadyPaired: One of these people already has a spouse. Unpair them first.

draw.title: Draw
draw.stillMissing: Still missing: {names}. The draw runs by itself when the last person sets a password.
draw.doneBody: Drawn on {date, date, short} at {date, time, short} · {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}. Results are private: only each giver can see their own, including you.

failedReasons.too_few_people: There aren't enough people for a draw. Add at least one more person.
failedReasons.no_valid_assignment: No valid assignment exists with the current spouse pairs. Add more people or remove a spouse pair, then run the draw again.
failedReasons.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Try running the draw again.

draw.staleTitle: The group changed after the draw
draw.staleBody: Current results don't include the latest changes. Run a new draw to include everyone.
draw.staleDialogBody: Do you want to run a new draw?
draw.resetBody: Clears every result. A new draw runs as soon as everyone is signed up. Adding or removing a person after the draw also asks you about this.
draw.resetDialogBody: Everyone's current result will be deleted. People who already opened their gift will get a new match.

empty.title: No one here yet
empty.body: Add everyone taking part, pair the spouses, then share the link with the group.
empty.warning: Add the whole group before sharing the link: the draw starts as soon as everyone on the list has a password.

admin.comingSoon: The admin panel is on its way.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
